description: Lets Ternwire send email from your domain: a DKIM key, plus the MX and SPF records of a send subdomain used as the return path. Your website and existing mailboxes are not changed.
variableDescription: %dkimSelector%: DKIM selector issued for this domain; %dkimKey%: DKIM public key issued for this domain; %region%: AWS region of the sending service
